newsitem.title: USA: CV, Biogen begin Phase II trials.
newsitem.headline: CV, Biogen begin Phase II trials.

text.p: CV Therapeutics Inc said it has begun a Phase II study of its CVT-124 compound in patients with congestive heart failure. The study is being conducted in collaboration with Biogen Inc.
CV said it expects to complete the trial later this year.

In March, CV and Biogen signed an agreement to collaborate on the development of CVT-124. Biogen has exclusive worldwide rights to develop and sell the drug, and will pay all costs of commercializing the product. CV received from Biogen up-front payments totaling $16 million and may receive significant milestone payments on royalties on clinical progress and product sales.
